placeholders.<session:N>: a session id the server mints, sess_ and 16 lowercase hex
placeholders.<timestamp>: an ISO-8601 time on a date within 31 days of the run's clock (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, optional fraction, Z or offset)
placeholders.<ulid:N>: a ULID minted during the run (its time part within 31 days of the run's clock); N numbers distinct values in order of first appearance in the file

read: Each record runs `bettermemory hook <event> <argv>` in process (`_daemon_client.hook_main`) with stdin the harness's payload and env added to the environment; the client finds its daemon at port 7397 with token 'fixture-token-not-a-secret' (client.wrong_token: the client holds another token; client.daemon_unreachable: the connection is refused, errno 111). exchanges: each request the client sent (method, url, headers, JSON body) and the daemon's status and reply; the client's nonce is fixed (nonce). stdout, stderr, exit_code: what the client printed to Claude Code. A reply's chars is counted over its stdout as written here (a scratch path as <scratch>); the product counts the path as it is. Records run in file order on one app and store: session_start.empty_store runs before the seed records are put; the prompt recall's cooldown and the Stop audit read what earlier records wrote.

seed.how: Store.put_memory of each record, homed in the checkout's project (location.resolve_caller(store, config, <scratch>/alpha).home()), created and updated age_days before the run's clock (seconds kept, microseconds dropped), after session_start.empty_store

setup: build_app(config, store, token, shutdown, version) with Config(storage=StorageConfig(directory=<scratch>/mem), behavior=BehaviorConfig(), scopes=ScopesConfig()), every other setting at the package default, over Store.create(<scratch>/mem/store) migrated as a daemon start migrates it (daemon._migrate_at_start); no port is passed, so the Host check takes any port on a loopback name. Requests go to http://127.0.0.1:7397 in process. Here the capture checkpoint is on: Config.capture = CaptureConfig(stop_checkpoint=True, checkpoint_tokens=500), its other fields at their defaults.
